speaker: Doctor
text: I am Dr. Agent. I see you are a pediatric patient with a 3-week history of fatigue, fever, easy bruising, and severe leg pain. To understand your condition better, how old are you, and have you noticed any bone pain specifically in your legs or hips?

speaker: Patient
text: 4-year-old girl. The patient has been experiencing generalized fatigue and easy bruising for 3 weeks. Over the past week, she has developed a fever and severe leg pain that wakes her up at night.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Acute Lymphoblastic Leukemia (ALL)

The combination of prolonged fatigue, easy bruising, night pain, and fever in a 4-year-old female is highly suggestive of ALL. REQUEST TEST: Complete Blood Count with Differential. REQUEST IMAGES: Peripheral Blood Smear and Pelvic_X-Ray.
